name: GitHub Build Monitor
author: David JM
description: Real-time GitHub Actions status for your repositories, shown in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shows the state of the most recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for your repositories and opens a detailed list.

schema.label: Repositories
schema.description: Comma-separated owner/name pairs, e.g. HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell, cli/cli

schema.label: GitHub token
schema.description: Optional personal access token (also read from the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable). Raises the API rate limit to 5000 req/h.

schema.label: API host
schema.description: Leave empty for github.com. Set for GitHub Enterprise (e.g. github.example.com).
